notes: Program dates may change. Contact: BCAPstudentgroup@gmail.com or (313) 577-1584.
name: Biomedical Career Advancement Program (BCAP)
org: Wayne State University School of Medicine and MI-AHEC Southeast Regional Center
what_you_do: Work with research mentors in a lab for 6 weeks, build your own research project, and present it at a symposium. Fridays have lab safety, CPR, and career panels.
who_can_apply: High school students in 10th, 11th or 12th grade with a GPA of 2.75 or higher. Priority goes to Wayne County residents, Detroit Public Schools Community District students, and students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
pay_detail: Students who finish may get a monetary award. It depends on funding and is not guaranteed.
duration: 6 weeks. Monday to Thursday up to 5 hours a day, plus Friday events 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications ran Feb 23 to Apr 24, 2026 (5 p.m.). Program ran July 6 to Aug 14, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application and write a 300 to 400 word personal statement. An official transcript is needed if you are accepted.
